newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican Nov retail sales down 0.4 pct, data shows.
newsitem.headline: Mexican Nov retail sales down 0.4 pct, data shows.

text.p: Mexican retail sales fell 0.4 percent in November, while wholesale sales rose 2.6 percent, data released by the National Statistics Institute (INEGI) showed.

INEGI gave no percentage changes for November data when it released December sales figures on Wednesday. But in a table it said the retail sales index fell to 79.4 in November from 79.7 the same month the previous year, while the wholesale index rose from 91.6 to 94.0.
In a Reuters survey, analysts had expected a rise in retail sales of 1.95 percent and a 5.15 percent increase in wholesale sales.
INEGI did not say why it ommitted the November change, which it had been scheduled to issue.
Like November, the actual December figures released by INEGI were lower than expected. Retail sales fell 1.9 percent, while wholesale sales rose 9.2 percent, compared with the same month in 1995.
